primary_question.question: Why does my Lemon Rice stick or tear?
evidence: Do not use very hot rice, or it may turn sticky

related_questions.question: Why is my Lemon Rice too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not touch your eyes after handling green chilli

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Lemon Rice?
evidence: Do not add lemon juice to hot oil

related_questions.question: Why does my Lemon Rice taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not cook too long after adding asafoetida, or it may taste bitter

related_questions.question: Why is my Lemon Rice too dense or dry?
evidence: Do not add wet curry leaves without patting them dry
